verses.text: <pb/><t>Ahurum Jehova n'anya, n'ihi na Ọ nānu</t> <t>Olum, bú aririọ-amaram nile.</t>
<t>N'ihi na Ọ tọwo nti-Ya n'ala n'ebe m'nọ,</t> <t>Ogologo ubọchi nile nke ndum ka m'ga-akpọku kwa Ya.</t>
<t>Udọ̀ nile nke ọnwu b͕aram buruburu,</t> <t>Ebe nile di nkpà nke ala-mọ chọtaram:</t> <t>Ahuhu na iru-újú ka m'nāhu.</t>
<t>M'we kpọkue aha Jehova;</t> <t>Si, Biko, Jehova, me ka nkpuru-obim wepuga onwe-ya.</t>
<t>Onye-amara na onye ezi omume ka Jehova bu;</t> <t>E, Chineke-ayi nwere obi-ebere.</t>
<t>Onye nēdebe ndi nēnweghi uche ka Jehova bu:</t> <t>Enweghm ike, O we nyem nzọputa.</t>
<t>Nkpuru-obim, laghachi n'ebe-izu-ike-gi;</t> <t>N'ihi na Jehova emesowo gi nke-ọma.</t>
<t>N'ihi na I naputawo nkpuru-obim n'ọnwu,</t> <t>I naputawo kwa anyam abua n'anya-miri,</t> <t>I naputawo kwa ukwum abua na nnuda anēnudam.</t>
<t>M'gējeghari n'iru Jehova</t> <t>N'ala nile nke ndi di ndu.</t>
<t>Ekwerewom, n'ihi na m'nēkwu okwu:</t> <t>Ewedara mu onwem n'ala nke-uku:</t>
<t>Mu onwem siri na nkujam</t> <t>Madu ọ bula bu onye nēkwu okwu-ugha.</t>
<t>M'gēsi aṅa nyeghachi Jehova</t> <t>Nmeso ọma Ya nile O mesoworom?</t>
<t>Iko nke nzọputa nile ka m'gēbuli,</t> <t>Ọ bu kwa aha Jehova ka m'gākpọku.</t>
<t>Ka m'kwughachi Jehova nkwa nile m'kwere,</t> <t>Ka m'kwughachi ha n'iru ndi-Ya nile.</t>
<t>Ihe di oké ọnu-ahia n'anya Jehova</t> <t>Ka ọnwu nke diri ndi-ebere-Ya bu.</t>
<t>Ariọm I, Jehova, n'ihi na mu onwem bu orù-Gi:</t> <t>Mu onwem bu orù-Gi, na nwa nke orù-Gi nwayi;</t> <t>I tọpuwo ab͕um nile.</t>
<t>Gi ka m'gāchuru aja ekele,</t> <t>Ọ bu kwa aha Jehova ka m'gākpọku.</t>
<t>Ka m'kwughachi Jehova nkwa nile m'kwere,</t> <t>Ka m'kwughachi ha n'iru ndi-Ya nile;</t>
<t>N'ogige nile nke ulo Jehova,</t> <t>N'etiti gi, Jerusalem.</t> <t>Tonu Ja.</t>
